## `cidx server`

Usage: `cidx server [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...`

```text
Manage CIDX multi-user server lifecycle.

Control server start, stop, status, and restart operations with
proper graceful shutdown and health monitoring.
```

| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| [`add-index`](#cidx-server-add-index) | Add an index type to a golden repository. |
| [`auto-update-status`](#cidx-server-auto-update-status) | Check status of auto-update service. |
| [`install-auto-update`](#cidx-server-install-auto-update) | Install and enable auto-update service for CIDX server. |
| [`list-indexes`](#cidx-server-list-indexes) | List index status for a golden repository. |
| [`restart`](#cidx-server-restart) | Restart the CIDX multi-user server. |
| [`start`](#cidx-server-start) | Start the CIDX multi-user server. |
| [`status`](#cidx-server-status) | Check CIDX multi-user server status and health. |
| [`stop`](#cidx-server-stop) | Stop the CIDX multi-user server gracefully. |
| [`temporal-migrate-legacy`](#cidx-server-temporal-migrate-legacy) | Relocate legacy temporal shards into fixed server-owned storage. |
| [`uninstall-auto-update`](#cidx-server-uninstall-auto-update) | Uninstall and disable auto-update service for CIDX server. |

## `cidx server add-index`

Usage: `cidx server add-index [OPTIONS] ALIAS {semantic|fts|temporal|scip}`

```text
Add an index type to a golden repository.

ALIAS is the golden repository alias.
INDEX_TYPE is one of: semantic, fts, temporal, scip
```

| Argument | Type | Required |
|----------|------|----------|
| `ALIAS` | text | yes |
| `INDEX_TYPE` | choice: `semantic`, `fts`, `temporal`, `scip` | yes |

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|--------|------|---------|----------|-------------|
| `--quiet` | flag |  | no | Minimal output for scripting |
| `--wait` | flag |  | no | Wait for job completion |
| `--timeout` | integer | `1800` | no | Timeout in seconds for --wait (default: 1800) |

## `cidx server auto-update-status`

Usage: `cidx server auto-update-status [OPTIONS]`

```text
Check status of auto-update service.

Shows timer status, last run time, and deployment result.
```

## `cidx server install-auto-update`

Usage: `cidx server install-auto-update [OPTIONS]`

```text
Install and enable auto-update service for CIDX server.

Installs systemd service and timer that automatically deploys
updates when changes are pushed to the tracked branch (--branch,
default: master).
```

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|--------|------|---------|----------|-------------|
| `--branch` | text | `master` | no | Git branch for the auto-updater to track (CIDX_AUTO_UPDATE_BRANCH). |

## `cidx server restart`

Usage: `cidx server restart [OPTIONS]`

```text
Restart the CIDX multi-user server.

Gracefully stops the server if running, waits for proper shutdown,
then starts with updated configuration. If not running, simply starts.
```

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|--------|------|---------|----------|-------------|
| `--server-dir` | path |  | no | Server directory path (default: ~/.cidx-server) |

## `cidx server start`

Usage: `cidx server start [OPTIONS]`

```text
Start the CIDX multi-user server.

Validates configuration, starts the FastAPI server process, and
returns success confirmation with server URL.
```

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|--------|------|---------|----------|-------------|
| `--server-dir` | path |  | no | Server directory path (default: ~/.cidx-server) |

## `cidx server status`

Usage: `cidx server status [OPTIONS]`

```text
Check CIDX multi-user server status and health.

Shows server status, uptime, port, active jobs, and recent errors.
Use --verbose for detailed health information including resource usage.
```

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|--------|------|---------|----------|-------------|
| `--verbose`, `-v` | flag |  | no | Show detailed health information |
| `--server-dir` | path |  | no | Server directory path (default: ~/.cidx-server) |

## `cidx server stop`

Usage: `cidx server stop [OPTIONS]`

```text
Stop the CIDX multi-user server gracefully.

Performs graceful shutdown by default, waiting for background jobs
to complete and saving pending data. Use --force for immediate shutdown.
```

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|--------|------|---------|----------|-------------|
| `--force`, `-f` | flag |  | no | Force shutdown (send SIGKILL instead of graceful SIGTERM) |
| `--server-dir` | path |  | no | Server directory path (default: ~/.cidx-server) |

## `cidx server temporal-migrate-legacy`

Usage: `cidx server temporal-migrate-legacy [OPTIONS]`

```text
Relocate legacy temporal shards into fixed server-owned storage.

Issue #1548 blocker 6: respects the two independent, Web-UI-gated
temporal_legacy_migration_config flags (relocation_enabled /
cleanup_authorized) -- this command NEVER proceeds against operator
intent just because it was invoked.
```

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|--------|------|---------|----------|-------------|
| `--alias` | text |  | no | Migrate only this alias |
| `--cleanup` | flag |  | no | Delete each legacy shard only after verification succeeds |

## `cidx server uninstall-auto-update`

Usage: `cidx server uninstall-auto-update [OPTIONS]`

```text
Uninstall and disable auto-update service for CIDX server.

Stops and disables the systemd timer, removes service files.
```
